messages:
Alex: quick sync — opened PR #8220 that updates onprem auth bindings + vault path renames. Touches k8s SA roles, service account annotations, and a small migration script. Link: https://git.redwood/8220

Maria: can you enumerate changed files and confirm whether any secrets are checked in or new long-lived tokens are introduced? also need to know if audit path names change (so logging/rbac teams can update dashboards).

Alex: changed files: `deploy/onprem/sa-roles.yaml`, `services/agent/config/vault_paths.md`, `scripts/vault_rename.sh`, `infra/terraform/kms_keys.tf` (only metadata refs). No plaintext secrets checked in. `vault_rename.sh` performs `vault kv metadata move` + updates TTLs and service principals.

Samir: CI flagged a failure on `integration/secrets-mount` — looks like a permission edge on the mount namespace, could be a test flake but it blocks the merge bot. CI job: https://ci.redwood/job/8220/17

ci-bot: Build status: FAILURE
Last failing step: integration/secrets-mount
```
ERROR: failed to create tmp mount (permission denied)
```

Tilly: I'd prefer we don't land the KMS terraform bits until we can validate egress rules and HSM fallback. Suggest splitting: PR A = SA + vault rename (low-risk), PR B = kms key/policy tf (requires infra/security signoff). Can run a 2-node canary in staging for PR A.

Maria: splitting sounds good. For PR B I need the KMS key policy doc and a statement of whether this will allow customer-managed keys vs platform keys. also need to know whether `vault_rename.sh` changes audit log paths (yes/no).

Alex: will split now. `vault_rename.sh` WILL change secret paths (old -> new) and emits a migration log to `/var/log/vault-migrations.log` (we append entries). No change to audit ingestion config. KMS policy doc is linked in the PR description for the tf change (PR #8220-b).

Samir: after split, please run the integration suite locally (docker-compose/integration) and paste failing logs if any. If the mount error repeats, maybe it's a serviceaccount annotation that sets fsGroup incorrectly.

Alex: running tests locally, reproducing the mount error — looks like we forgot to set `volumeMount.securityContext: runAsNonRoot` in the helm chart for agent. Pushing a fix to PR #8220-a.

Maria: good catch. once CI passes I can do a quick code review for SA scopes. For PR B I'll wait for Ryan to confirm HSM & rotation constraints.

Ryan: I'll review KMS policy & HSM requirements tomorrow 09:30 PT. If we need an HSM-only flow, we should add a feature flag and document key import/export constraints. I'll post a checklist here after review.

Tilly: plan for rollout: if PR #8220-a has green CI and 2 approvers, merge window tomorrow 07:00 PT. I'll queue a canary job to run in `staging-ny` (2 nodes) then `staging-eu` if healthy. Notify me when merged.

Alex: ack — aiming for 07:00 PT. splitting now, new PRs: #8220-a (SA + vault rename + mount fix) and #8220-b (KMS tf). tagging reviewers @Maria @Ryan.

Samir: FYI, if PR A lands, downstream consumer service `ingest-agent` may need its env var `VAULT_PATH` updated; add a migration note to the changelog.

Alex: added migration note to `docs/onprem/migration_notes.md` and a post-deploy checklist with rollback steps (revert vault path via `vault kv metadata move` back).

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll aim to review PR B later tonight but won't approve until Ryan confirms HSM/rotation behaviour.

Tilly: ping me after merge and I'll kick off the canary. If anything odd shows up, we'll rollback immediately.

Alex: thanks all — will update statuses here (CI link + canary logs) once available.
